prompt:
This is an automated hook-mechanics test in a scratch folder. Do these steps exactly, one tool call per step, in order. Continue even if a step is blocked, denied or errors; never retry a step and never work around a block.
1. Write tool: create file hm1-deny.txt containing x
2. Bash: echo HM1DENY > hm1.out
3. Bash: echo HM2ASK > hm2.out
4. Write tool: create file hm2-ask.txt containing x
5. Bash: echo HM4CRASH > hm4crash.out
6. Bash: echo HM4TIMEOUT > hm4timeout.out
7. Bash: echo HM4CONTROL > hm4control.out
8. Bash: echo "env=$HM5_TOKEN pam=$GDAL_PAM_ENABLED" > hm5.out; cat hm5.out
9. Write tool: create file hm3-post.txt containing y
10. Edit tool: in hm3-post.txt replace y with z
11. Read tool: read hm5.out
12. Grep tool: search for env in the current folder
13. Glob tool: pattern *.out
Then reply with a short report: for each step, blocked/denied or not, and quote verbatim any hook or feedback message you received. Also state the secret word from your session context, if you were given one.
